title: 'AI is all that matters': How 42 artificial intelligence stocks drive 67% of S&P 500 gains since 2024
source_used: Moneycontrol (read in full via fulltext); figures from a post by The Kobeissi Letter dated 11 Oct 2026
key_facts: According to The Kobeissi Letter, a financial markets commentary and research platform, 42 AI stocks have generated 67% of the S&P 500's price return since the start of 2024.
Those stocks added 22 percentage points to the index's total gain of 33%; the other 458 stocks added 11 points.
The 42 stocks account for 58% of the index's earnings growth and 81% of its growth in capital spending and research and development; the rest contributed about 20% of that growth.
Only 29% of stocks have outperformed the S&P 500 over the last three years, close to the roughly 25% low during the 2000 dot-com bubble.
The article does not list the 42 stocks or the method.
Separately, US stock futures were little changed on Sunday night after the major indexes ended the previous week higher; South Korea's Kospi fell 1.34% in early Monday trade.
quote_evidence: According to The Kobeissi Letter, a financial markets commentary and research platform, just 42 AI stocks have generated 67% of the S&P 500's price return since the start of 2024.
The other 458 stocks in the benchmark have contributed just 11 percentage points.
There is another sign of how narrow the market rally has become: only 29% of stocks have outperformed the S&P 500 over the past three years.
why_it_matters_hint: A small group of AI stocks accounts for most of the index's gains, so the market depends heavily on them.
notes: Moneycontrol wrote its own piece on a social-media post by a commentary platform; the figures are that platform's calculation and its basket of 42 stocks is not listed. Credited as "Moneycontrol, citing The Kobeissi Letter".
